description.value:
Until the power ends, any creature that targets the warded creature with an attack, a harmful power, or another hostile act must first succeed on a Wisdom save; failure forces it to redirect at a different target or abandon the attack or power entirely. Area effects are unaffected by this protection.

The power ends immediately if the warded creature attacks, casts a power targeting an enemy, or takes a hostile action of its own.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
